hitPoints.atHigherLevels: 1d12 (or 7) + your Constitution modifier per barbarian level after 1st

options: a martial melee weapon and two handaxes

features.name: Rage
features.description: As a bonus action, you can enter a rage, gaining advantage on Strength checks and saves, +2 damage on Strength melee weapon attacks, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Your rage lasts 1 minute and ends early if you fall unconscious or if your turn ends without attacking or taking damage.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While not wearing armor, your AC equals 10 + Dex modifier + Con modifier. You can use a shield.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.description: When you make your first attack on your turn, you can attack recklessly, gaining advantage on Strength attack rolls but giving attackers advantage against you until your next turn.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.description: You have advantage on Dexterity saves against effects you can see, like spells and traps (not unseen attacks).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, when you take the Attack action. (Increases to 3 at 11th, 4 at 17th.)

features.name: Fast Movement
features.description: Your speed increases by 10 feet while not wearing heavy armor.

features.name: Feral Instinct
features.description: You have advantage on initiative rolls. If you are surprised, you can still act normally on your first turn as long as you enter rage.

features.name: Brutal Critical
features.description: Roll extra damage dice when you score a critical hit with a melee attack (1 at 9th, 2 at 13th, 3 at 17th).

features.name: Relentless Rage
features.description: If you drop to 0 HP while raging, you can make a Constitution save to instead drop to a number of HP equal to twice your barbarian level. The save DC increases by 5 each time you use it after the first in a rage.

features.name: Persistent Rage
features.description: Your rage ends only if you choose to end it or fall unconscious.

features.name: Indomitable Might
features.description: If your Strength check total is less than your Strength score, you can use your Strength score in place of the check total.

features.name: Primal Champion
features.description: Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4, to a maximum of 24.

subclasses.name: Berserker
subclasses.description: The Path of the Berserker emphasizes brute force and uncontrolled fury.

features.name: Frenzy
features.description: You can make a single melee attack as a bonus action on each of your turns while raging.

features.name: Mindless Rage
features.description: You can't be charmed or frightened while raging.

features.name: Intimidating Presence
features.description: As an action, you can frighten a creature within 30 feet with a Wisdom save (DC = 8 + Prof + Cha). The effect ends if you or your allies attack or deal damage to it.

features.name: Retaliation
features.description: When you take damage from a creature within 5 feet, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against that creature.

subclasses.name: Path of the Wild Heart
subclasses.description_en: You draw on the primal bond between barbarian and beast. Animals sense your kinship and your rage lets you channel beast-like power.
subclasses.description_es: Te nutres del vínculo primordial entre bárbaro y bestia. Los animales perciben tu afinidad y tu furia canaliza un poder bestial.

features.name: Animal Speaker
features.description: Through sound and gesture, you gain the ability to communicate with Beasts and you always know their location within 30 ft of you.

features.name: Aspect of the Wild
features.description: You gain resistance to a damage type based on your aspect: Bear (force your mark), Eagle (knock back), Wolf (push effect).

features.name: Bestial Soul
features.description: You gain a flying speed 30 ft OR a swimming speed 30 ft OR a climb speed 30 ft.

features.name: Wilderness Magician
features.description: You learn spells from the druid spell list (Wisdom saves).

subclasses.name: Path of the World Tree
subclasses.description_en: Your rage harnesses the resilience of Yggdrasil, the World Tree. You can call on the cosmos for protection.
subclasses.description_es: Tu furia canaliza la fortaleza de Yggdrasil, el Árbol del Mundo. Puedes invocar la protección del cosmos.

features.name: World Tree Walker
features.description: You gain a climb speed equal to your walking speed.

features.name: Branches of the Tree
features.description: While raging, you gain 2d6 temp HP at the start of each turn.

features.name: Verdant Pierce
features.description: Vertically grow branches that turn into piercing damage behind you.

features.name: Mighty Descent
features.description: You can reduce falling damage; once per long rest, knock prone all creatures in 30-ft radius on impact.

subclasses.name: Path of the Zealot
subclasses.description_en: Your rage is fueled by a fierce devotion to a deity, cause, or creed. You undergo divine transformations in battle.
subclasses.description_es: Tu furia se alimenta de una devoción feroz a una deidad, causa o credo. Sufres transformaciones divinas en batalla.

features.name: Divine Fury
features.description: While raging, the first creature you hit on each turn takes extra 1d6 + half barb level radiant or necrotic damage (your choice).

features.name: Warrior of the Gods
features.description: Spell resurrection targeting you has a 50% chance of failure.

features.name: Frenzied Focus
features.description: Gain advantage on Constitution saves when raging.

features.name: Zealous Presence
features.description: As an action, force Wisdom save on creatures in 60-ft radius; on fail, charmed or frightened 1 min (you choose).

subclasses.name: Wild Heart
subclasses.description: Path of the Wild Heart features a magical animal guide that grants you supernatural boons.

features.name: Animal Speaker
features.description: You can cast Speak with Animals as a ritual.

features.name: Raging Flora and Fauna
features.description: While raging, plants grow around you and creatures sense you as a primal predator, granting advantage on Intimidation and Survival.

features.name: Spirit Walk
features.description: You can cast Tree Stride once per long rest.

features.name: Wrath of the Nature
features.description: While raging, you can cast Call Lightning as a bonus action.
